summary: The principal stops and removals are Piercing Hiss, Toxic Atrophy, Mass Envenom, Paralyzing Shots, Envenom, and Ravenous Claws.
actions: Interrupt Piercing Hiss from Primal Serpents.
Plan interrupts for the Writhing Coil's three successive Toxic Atrophy casts.
Interrupt Mass Envenom from Ula'tek's Chosen; remove its poison only as recovery if the cast completes.
Remove Paralyzing Shots as Magic or use an eligible snare-removal effect.
Use a purge or short control/kiting window against the Ravenous Descendant's stacking attack-speed threat.

provenance.description: Interrupt, dispel, and enrage flags derived from Mythic Dungeon Tools 6.2.10.
Priority classification and responses corroborated through targeted review of Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview and spell pages.
